title: Bot catalogue schild.bot_catalogue/0.1 (v0.5, MVP-22, D35)
description: Known bots and the address ranges their operators publish, shipped in the schild binary with every release (decided 2026-10-29: catalogue and range snapshots travel with releases and the signed rule bundle; a direct fetch from the operators is optional and off, bots.ranges_fetch). Seeded from ai.robots.txt robots.json (MIT, attribution in client/NOTICE) plus own search, SEO, monitoring and preview entries. Works fully offline. Matching and verification are fixed by contract/bots (Go) and contracts/tools/crosscheck.py (Python), checked by the bot-match vectors: (1) the first 512 bytes of the User-Agent, ASCII lower-cased, are searched for every ua_match token (ASCII case-insensitive substring); the longest matching token wins, on a tie the earlier bot. (2) Without a match the category is likely_automated when the User-Agent is empty, does not start with 'mozilla/' or contains an automation_tokens entry, otherwise likely_browser; no bot, no verification. (3) A matched bot is verified when bots.verify.fcrdns is on and the forward-confirmed reverse name ends in one of its rdns_suffixes, or when bots.verify.ranges is on and the client address (IPv4-mapped IPv6 unmapped) is in a prefix of its range set and the set was fetched at most 30 days ago; otherwise mismatch when the address is outside a fresh range set or the confirmed name has another suffix ('gibt sich als ... aus'), otherwise unknown_stale when its range set is older than 30 days, otherwise claimed (the operator publishes nothing, or the check is off). Semantic checks (code schema): unique bot, range set and source ids, every verify.ranges names a range set and every bot source a source, prefixes are canonical (no host bits, no IPv4-mapped IPv6), ua_match and automation_tokens are unique ASCII case-insensitively across the whole catalogue.

version.description: Date of the catalogue and a counter, e.g. 2026-10-29.1; shown in the dashboard.

sources.description: Where entries come from, with licence (attribution).

automation_tokens.description: Generic tokens of automated clients for user agents no bot matches (e.g. bot, crawl, spider, scrape, headless, python, curl).

token.description: Printable ASCII, no leading or trailing space.

category.description: Catalogue categories (the first eleven of BotCategory in client-dashboard.openapi.yaml).

robots_token.description: The user-agent token the bot obeys in robots.txt (for the robots.txt view).

verify.description: How an address is checked. Empty: the operator publishes nothing, the bot is always claimed.

ranges.description: Id of a range set in ranges.

rdns_suffixes.description: Domains a forward-confirmed reverse name must end in (FCrDNS, only with bots.verify.fcrdns).

source.description: Id of the source in sources (absent: own entry).

url.description: Where the operator publishes the ranges (fetched for the snapshot; at runtime only with bots.ranges_fetch).
